note: Modules Weight is a UI + Drush front end over core module_set_weight(); module weights live in core.extension -> module.<name> (lower runs earlier). Config modules_weight.settings has one key show_system_modules (bool, default FALSE) deciding whether Core modules are shown/reorderable. Routes: modules_weight.list_page (reorder form) and modules_weight.modules_weight_admin_settings (configure). Permission: administer modules weight. Drush: mw-list (mw-l), mw-reorder (mw-r), mw-show-system-modules (mw-ssm). Service modules_weight (getModulesList). Medium/hard cases are grounded in real state: the modules_weight module's own weight in core.extension and the show_system_modules config value.

evals.prompt: Which Drush command from the modules_weight module sets a module's weight (execution order), and which lists all modules with their weights?
evals.expected_output: drush mw-reorder <module> <weight> sets a module's weight (alias mw-r); drush mw-list prints the modules-and-weights table (alias mw-l). mw-show-system-modules (mw-ssm) toggles whether Core modules are shown.

evals.prompt: When you change a module's weight with the modules_weight module, where is that weight actually stored in Drupal, and which core function applies it?
evals.expected_output: Weights are stored in the core.extension config object under module.<machine_name> (lower runs earlier), applied via core's module_set_weight(). Modules Weight is just a UI/Drush front end over it.

evals.prompt: In the modules_weight module, what does the show_system_modules setting control and what config object holds it?
evals.expected_output: show_system_modules (in config modules_weight.settings, default FALSE) controls whether Drupal Core modules appear in the reorder list and can be reordered.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, inspect the module execution order and give the current weight of the 'modules_weight' module itself.
On this site, is the modules_weight module currently configured to show and allow reordering of Drupal Core modules? Inspect the live configuration and answer.
evals.expected_output: Yes - modules_weight.settings show_system_modules is TRUE, so Core modules are shown/reorderable.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, use the modules_weight module to set the weight of the 'modules_weight' module itself to 5 (so its hooks run later). Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set the modules_weight module's weight to 5, e.g. drush mw-reorder modules_weight 5 (or module_set_weight('modules_weight', 5)); core.extension module.modules_weight becomes 5.

evals.prompt: I want to be able to reorder Drupal's core modules too, not just the add-on ones. Using the modules_weight module, turn on the option that shows the system/core modules on this live site.
evals.expected_output: Set show_system_modules to TRUE, e.g. drush mw-show-system-modules on (or set modules_weight.settings show_system_modules true).
